reports.title: National Summary Data Page — Botswana
reports.description: Botswana's National Summary Data Page as described and linked by the Bank of Botswana, which hosts the page on behalf of all three national producers of official statistics (the Bank of Botswana, the Ministry of Finance and Economic Development, and Statistics Botswana). Implemented under the IMF's Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS) as of end-January 2016, with Botswana cited by the Bank itself as the first country to introduce the enhanced-format NSDP. The IMF's own dsbb.imf.org endpoint carries no NSDPUrl for e-GDDS participants (unlike SDDS/SDDS Plus), so this anchor is drawn from Botswana's own site rather than the IMF's.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated data page (its own live render is on a linked third-party platform, updated as each producer releases new data), not a discrete-edition publication. 250 follows the same renderer convention used for the NSDP block and for India's NSDP (round 18, HANDOFF section 7 / 2026-08-18) — a nominal releases_per_year so the pulse reads as continuous rather than one-off.
